items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: there wasn't no string bass out here but me and Montuti.

ctx.x: Oh, I heard of him, too.

Yeah. See? Did he pick the bass? He was picking, picking, picking, wasn't slapping, just picking. Picking it. Oh, yes. See? So, so, they can't, they can't give those, those guys credit. But when I come, when I went around New York, when I left Los Angeles, even in L.A., in 22, there wasn't no string bass out here but me and Montuti. See, nobody didn't pay no attention to Montuti. Didn't start to pay attention to Montuti until I come out here with the Ory band. After I went, Ory went with the black and tan band,…
